items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-12-23
items.q: But Shea was a tough guy too, wasn't he?

ctx.x: That's right, we were working at Plantation. And he went with this fiddle player, I can't call his name, he had a pretty good band at that time. And this fiddle player had an argument, understanding that this fiddle player beat him, give him a good beating. Very bad beating, so I can understand. And next I heard that they found him in the alley there, but I don't know if it's got killed him or not. I mean, I know he was a sassy boy. He was a bad boy. Well, he had some bad boys. Huh?
He had some bad boys. Yeah, he had quite a few bad boys, yeah. But Shea was a tough guy too, wasn't he? Yeah, I miss you.
Well, all of it was quick tempered. Yeah, he was quick tempered.
